subject: Kickoff: security questionnaire for Brightwell Health — clarifications & next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Klein <oliver.k@brightwellhealth.com>, Brightwell Health Security <security@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: security questionnaire for Brightwell Health — clarifications & next steps

Hi Oliver / Brightwell security team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and the open items we need to resolve before we start the vendor questionnaire: 

1) Compliance posture
- SOC 2: Do you require a Type II report or will Type I / SOC 2 summary suffice for initial ingestion? If Type II, what is the intended reporting period?
- HIPAA: You mentioned PHI scope could be limited to tokenized IDs. Can you confirm whether Redwood would be considered a Business Associate under your contract?
- GDPR: Any EU data residency constraints for the pilot (we currently offer EU-hosted private deployments if needed).

2) Questionnaire format preference
- SIG Lite / SIG / CAIQ or your custom security form? We can prefill a SIG Lite/Full if that speeds review — happy to do that and return a prefilled spreadsheet.

3) Evidence & timeline
- Primary evidence required (e.g., SOC 2 report PDF, architecture diagram, encryption key management screenshots).
- Target date for completed questionnaire and evidence: you mentioned internal compliance review week of 9/27 — is that still accurate?

4) Owners and access
- Point person from Brightwell for ongoing questions (name + email).
- Preferred upload method: secure Drive link (we can provide a limited-access folder) or email to security@brightwellhealth.com?

Attachments: I attached a short one-page checklist (brightwell_request.pdf) that maps the items we discussed.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm format (SIG/CAIQ/custom) and evidence list by EOD Monday 9/13.
- If SIG is fine, I’ll send a prefilled SIG spreadsheet and a Drive upload link the same day.
- Schedule a follow-up 30-minute sync for week of 9/20 to review open answers.

Thanks — I’ll loop Kim on the ops/answers side to help accelerate on our end.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
Attachment: brightwell_request.pdf (1 page checklist, PDF)
From: Oliver Klein <oliver.k@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightwell Health Security <security@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security questionnaire for Brightwell Health — clarifications & next steps

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the checklist, good summary. Answers inline below: 

> SOC 2: Do you require a Type II report or will Type I / SOC 2 summary suffice for initial ingestion?
We’d prefer Type II for production onboarding, but for the pilot a Type I or SOC 2 summary + SOC controls mapping is acceptable. Final decision will be made by our compliance manager (cc’d).

> HIPAA: Would Redwood be considered a Business Associate?
Yes, we anticipate that Redwood will be acting as a BAA vendor. Our legal team will draft the BAA; we can share the draft with your legal contact.

> GDPR: Any EU data residency constraints for the pilot?
No EU residency required for the pilot, but final deployment may require EU region hosting. Worth getting the EU hosting option on the table.

> Questionnaire format preference
We prefer starting with SIG Lite to speed things up. If that reveals gaps we’ll escalate to SIG Full.

> Evidence & timeline
Internal compliance review target still week of 9/27. I attached the formal request doc from our procurement team (brightwell_request.pdf).

> Owners and access
Primary: Oliver Klein (me) for commercial; Compliance: compliance@brightwellhealth.com (I copied Brightwell Health Security). Please provide a secure Drive link for uploads.

We’d appreciate a prefilled SIG Lite spreadsheet. If you can get that back by Mon 9/13 we’ll take a first pass.

Oliver
Oliver Klein
Head of Partnerships
Brightwell Health
oliver.k@brightwellhealth.com | +1 617-555-0199
